pois.name: Dominica Museum
pois.intro: The Dominica Museum is the national museum of Dominica, an island nation in the Caribbean Lesser Antilles. It is located in the capital, Roseau, on a quay in front of the Old Market of Roseau, which was the centre for slave trading during colonial times.

pois.name: Morne Trois Pitons National Park
pois.description: UNESCO World Heritage Site, volcanic landscape, endemic species, Boiling Lake, cloud forest
pois.intro: Morne Trois Pitons National Park is a national park in Dominica established in July 1975, the first to be legally established in the country. It became a World Heritage Site in 1997.

pois.name: Botanical Gardens
pois.intro: Dominica Botanic Gardens is located on the Caribbean island-nation of Dominica, in the capital of Roseau. Once known as one of the finest botanical gardens in the region, it was severely damaged by Hurricane David in 1979.

pois.name: Goverment House
pois.intro: The State House, located in Roseau, is the official residence of the president of Dominica. Previously it was used as the official residence of the colonial governors of Dominica.

pois.name: Trafalgar Falls
pois.intro: Die Trafalgar Falls sind ein Wasserfall auf der Karibikinsel Dominica. Der Wasserfall liegt im Parish Saint George.
